title: Will Asteroid 2024 YR4 Hit the Moon in 2032?
description:
Will Asteroid 2024 YR4 Hit the Moon in 2032?

Asteroid 2024 YR4, about 60 metres wide (matching a 15-storey building), had a 4.3% chance of lunar impact in early 2025 tracking for 22 December 2032. James Webb Space Telescope observations in February 2026 reduced that risk to 0%: it will safely miss the Moon at 21,200 kilometres.

Sources: NASA Planetary Defense & Webb (53-67 m / ~60 m, height of a 15-story building; 4.3% early-2025 lunar odds reduced to 0% by Webb Feb 2026 observations; passes 21,200 km from the lunar surface on 22 Dec 2032; no Earth impact risk).
https://science.nasa.gov/blogs/planetary-defense/2026/03/05/new-nasa-asteroid-observations-eliminate-chance-of-2032-lunar-impact/
https://science.nasa.gov/solar-system/asteroids/2024-yr4-facts/

Pictures: NASA imagery alongside our own 3D code-rendered graphics. Facts: every number is checked against the sources above.
Image credits: NASA; NASA/GSFC; NASA/JPL-Caltech; NASA/ESA/CSA/STScI.
